page.notes: The reference mark before "Si cui" is a small raised mark, read as "c" to match the marginal note "c Cap.8.". The first letter of the second paragraph is a large initial "I", read as "Jam" (iam, per rule). The word "defen-siuum" and "Re-ligionis" carry printed hyphens at line ends. The first paragraph's text runs from the previous page and has no visible start on this scan, so it is treated as a continuation. The left-hand page edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
